scenarios.name: happy_path
scenarios.details: deliver-project completed successfully with FACTORY_FORCE_MOCK=1; all 8 subdirs populated; run_state.json correctly serialized with all pipeline fields

scenarios.name: paused_construction
scenarios.technique: JSON mutation — set implementation_results=[] and finished_at=null in run_state.json
scenarios.details: No native pause checkpoint mechanism exists in PipelineRunState. 'Paused' state is inferred from empty implementation_results. Simulated by direct JSON mutation of run_state.json.

scenarios.name: continue_run
scenarios.details: continue-run is a STUB. cli.py:332-341 only echoes 'remaining milestones: [M2]' — no execution, no state transition, no resumption of pipeline. State remains paused after calling continue-run.

scenarios.name: replay_stability
scenarios.details: Replay executes successfully (exit 0) but is non-deterministic. Second replay produces different MD5 hashes for planning/milestones.json, planning/tasks.json, execution/milestone_M*.json, execution_calls.jsonl, verification/*, and run_state.json. Replay also mutates original run artifacts in-place with no snapshot protection.
scenarios.audit_annotation: state.errors[] appended with 'replayed from stage planning at <timestamp>'

scenarios.name: missing_file_handling
scenarios.details: Deleting a sidecar artifact (input/classification.json) does not affect continue-run since state is embedded in run_state.json. But using a nonexistent run_id raises raw FileNotFoundError traceback (Rich-formatted) with exit 1. No user-friendly error message.

scenarios.name: corrupt_json_handling
scenarios.details: Writing '{garbage' to run_state.json causes raw JSONDecodeError traceback on replay. No graceful error message like 'run_state.json is corrupt, please restore from backup'.

scenarios.name: invalid_state_handling
scenarios.details: Setting mode='invalid_state_value' in run_state.json causes Pydantic ValidationError traceback on continue-run. Message is technically informative ('Input should be dry-run or apply') but surfaces as raw traceback. replay --from-stage invalid_stage raises ValueError with valid stage list but also as raw traceback.

findings.title: continue-run is a non-functional stub
findings.detail: cli.py:332-341 only echoes remaining milestone IDs. No execution, no state transition, no 'done' outcome. Any user relying on continue-run to resume a paused pipeline will be misled by exit 0 + no-op behavior.

findings.title: Missing run / nonexistent run_id raises raw FileNotFoundError
findings.detail: RunState.load() raises FileNotFoundError unhandled. CLI should catch and emit friendly 'Run <id> not found in <repo>' message with exit 2.

findings.title: Corrupted run_state.json raises raw JSONDecodeError
findings.detail: json_io.read_json() raises JSONDecodeError unhandled. CLI should catch and emit friendly 'run_state.json is corrupt or unreadable' with recovery hint.

findings.title: Invalid enum field in run_state.json raises raw Pydantic ValidationError
findings.detail: PipelineRunState.model_validate() raises ValidationError unhandled. CLI should catch and emit friendly validation summary with field-level guidance.

findings.title: replay is non-deterministic across invocations
findings.detail: All execution artifacts (milestones, tasks, implementation results) change between replays because LLM-backed agents regenerate content. Replay cannot be used as an audit-safe 'read-only verification' mechanism.

findings.title: replay mutates original run artifacts in-place
findings.detail: Replaying from 'planning' overwrites planning/milestones.json, planning/tasks.json, all execution artifacts, verification reports, and run_state.json with no backup/snapshot protection.

findings.title: No native pause/resume checkpoint mechanism
findings.detail: PipelineRunState has no 'status' field. Paused state must be simulated by JSON mutation. There is no way to interrupt a run cleanly and checkpoint it for later resumption.

findings.title: Pydantic protected_namespaces warning on every CLI invocation
findings.detail: AgentCard.model_hint and AgentSpec.model_settings trigger UserWarning on import. Should add model_config['protected_namespaces']=() to suppress.
